name: A Sticky Situation
summary: Gilveradin Sunchaser holds the original packaging for the Hinterlands Honey Ripple that Dran Droffers is after, and will help package it for a fee of two extra bottles. The bottles are in crates around the abandoned Horde base near Skulk Rock.

sections.title: A Matter of Packaging
sections.body: Dran Droffers seeks the ripple, and Gilveradin Sunchaser has the original packaging for it. The help is not free: Gilveradin wants two additional bottles for the trouble. Ten bottles of Hinterlands Honey Ripple are to be gathered and brought back to the camp.

sections.title: Ruins of Skulk Rock
sections.body: The crates stand around the abandoned Horde base near Skulk Rock. Foul slimes and oozes cling to the ruins, and rumor says some sort of master ooze leads them.

faq.q: Who wants the Hinterlands Honey Ripple packaged?
faq.answer: Dran Droffers is the one seeking the ripple, and Gilveradin Sunchaser has the original packaging for it, which is meant for Malton's father.

faq.q: What does Gilveradin charge for the packaging?
faq.answer: Gilveradin asks for two additional bottles of the ripple as a fee. Ten bottles are to be recovered from the crates.

faq.q: Where are the crates of Hinterlands Honey Ripple kept?
faq.answer: They are in crates around the abandoned Horde base near Skulk Rock in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: What is at the abandoned camp at Skulk Rock?
faq.answer: Foul slimes and oozes cling to the ruins, and rumor says a master ooze leads them.
